finding: Multiple SDC files may be listed in the project, but they are not simultaneously active by default. Official documentation explicitly permits only one enabled constraint file of a given type.

sources.exact_short_quote: When multiple files are added, the last one added takes effect by default.
only one file can be enabled
sources.rule: For same-type constraint/configuration files only one is enabled; creating or adding a new file disables the previous file.
